verses.text: Ha jun winh skuchan Azarías yuninal winhaj Obed, ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh,

ix elta winh scha' winhaj Asa chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: Mamin Asa, ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yet' t'a he masanil ex wetchonhab' aj Judá yet' ex yinhtilal Benjamín: Ha Jehová ayoch ket'ok tato ayonh och tzak'an yuj. Tato anhej t'ay tzonh tewi, ol tak'woknhej t'ayonh, palta tato ol kaktejkan jun, ol onh yaktejpaxkani.
Niwanxo tiempo to manhxook Dios te yel ayoch ket'ok, manhxa heb' sacerdote tz'ak'an k'ayb'ub'al, manhxa ley.
Haxo ix jawi yaelal t'a kib'anh, ix kak'anxioch ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal, ix onh skolanxi.
Ayik mantzak kak'och ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' chi', manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal sb'eyeq'ui, yujto te niwan yaelal ayoch t'a yib'anh masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ay heb' anima ix laj satlajel sb'a, ay pax juntzanh chonhab' ix satanel juntzanhxo chonhab', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an somchaj heb' yuj juntzanh niwak yaelal chi'.
Palta a ex tik, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'ool, yujto a Jehová ol paktzitan he munlajel tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Asa tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi', ix stek'b'an wal sb'a winh. Ix schekan winh ik'chajel masanil juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová ay t'a yol smakb'en Judá, t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a yoltak juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix schekan winh b'ochajxi jun altar ay t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil anima winh, heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi', t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' kotnak t'a yol yik Efraín, t'a yol yik Manasés yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, haton heb' jawinak kajan t'a skal heb', yujto tzijtum heb' kajan t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Jeroboam ix jawi kajan t'a yol smakb'en Judá yujto ix yil heb' to ayoch Jehová Dios yet' winhaj Asa chi'.
Haxo t'a yoxil ujal yik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa chi' reyal, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' silab' heb' t'a Jehová. 700 nok' wakax yet' 7 mil nok' kalnel ix yak' heb'. Haton nok' chi' ix yik'kanek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'ool t'a owal.
Hata' ix yak' sti' heb' to anhej Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham, ol yak' serwil heb' yet' smasanil sk'ool.
Ix yak' pax sti' heb', tato ay mach to manhok Jehová Dios syak' serwil, wach'chom icham anima, ma unin, winak, ma ix, yowalil schami.
Ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix yak'an sti' heb' t'a Jehová, ix spu'an k'een strompeta heb' yet' nok' ch'aak.

Masanil heb' ay t'a smakb'en Judá chi' ix tzalaj wal heb' yuj b'aj ix yak' sti' chi' t'a smasanil sk'ool, ix el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'an serwil Jehová. Yuj chi' ix kolwaj Jehová chi' yet' heb', junk'olal ix aj heb' yet' masanil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil.

Hanhejtona', ix yik'anel yopisio ix Maaca winhaj Asa chi', haton ix snun chichim winh, yujto ix schek ix b'ojok jun yechel Asera te yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha winhaj Asa chi' ix chekan mak'jipoj jun yechel chi', chok' ix aji. Ix schekan winh nhusjitz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el juntzanh lugar winh yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh t'a Israel, palta k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'anoch masanil k'een oro yet' k'een plata winh t'a yol templo, haton k'een ak'b'il t'a Jehová yuj winh yet' smam.
Malajnhej owal ix ochi, masanto yik 35 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal.
